newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian share prices up slightly in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian share prices up slightly in quiet trade.

text.p: Egyptian share prices showed a flicker of life in subdued pre-holiday trade on Wednesday, coaxing the index up a fraction on the last day of weekly trade before the Moslem feast of Eid al-Adha.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index inched 0.05 points higher to 389.22 points in low 43 million pounds ($12.6 million) turnover.
Of the 84 shares traded, 34 closed unchanged, 33 rose and 17 slipped.
Egyptians Abroad for Investment and Development led the field with 13.6 million pounds turnover, its share closing up 1.05 at 22.24.
The cement sector stuck to its usual high profile in terms of turnover value but their shares were little changed.
Amriyah Cement was busy with 4.27 million pounds, about the same trade as Tuesday, when brokers said local funds were buying large tranches, mostly in the cement sector.
Amriyah fell back 0.2 to close at 88.3 pounds.
Helwan Portland Cement shares were unchanged at 79.5 in 1.98 million pounds turnover.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 601.74 points from 605.02 points on Tuesday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 269.31 points from 268.37.
